power.jaymospowers.wind.desc: Fly like a superhero: Sprint to cruise, Sneak to lock speed. Hold a key to channel the wind.
power.jaymospowers.wind.key.ability_2: Hold up to 5s: Tailwind / on ground: gust blast (full = TNT)
power.jaymospowers.wind.key.ultimate: Cyclone Lance: a spear of wind along your aim (stuns while a mode is on)
item.jaymospowers.wind_gale_heart.lore1: Still turning, though nothing turns it.
death.attack.jaymospowers.wind_lance: %1$s was run through by a gale
power.jaymospowers.wind.key.starter: A faint cloak of wind: a little quicker, and hold Jump in the air to drift down
power.jaymospowers.wind.key.starter.name: Cloak of Wind
power.jaymospowers.wind.key.ability_4.co: Hold: Call Lightning in the rain (full in a thunderstorm); under a clear sky, Zephyr's Breath
message.jaymospowers.wind.mode_hungry: Too hungry to hold the storm.
item.jaymospowers.quarterstaff.wind: In a Wind power user's or wind sorcerer's hand every swing rides the gale; right click to vault.
message.jaymospowers.wind.no_storm: No storm overhead to call down.
message.jaymospowers.wind.shield_blown: Your wind tears the shield from your grip.
message.jaymospowers.wind.no_eating: The storm won't sit still long enough to eat.
message.jaymospowers.wind.cured_days: Three days on, the storm in you has blown itself out.
message.jaymospowers.wind.cured_snow: The snow smothers the storm in you. The static is gone.
power.jaymospowers.wind.key.special: Tap: Tempest Kick (everything mastered), a crescent of wind, 5 blocks. Hold on the ground: Cyclone, whirls everything up and flings it away. Sneak + hold: Wind Whistle, lean over and blow a whistling blast of wind where you look (18 blocks) that blows out fire, clears smoke and fills a ship's sails. Meeting another held stream head-on (a Smoke Jet, another Whistle), it locks into a beam clash: hold on and mash X to drive the knot onto them
power.jaymospowers.wind.key.special.name: Tempest Kick / Cyclone / Wind Whistle
message.jaymospowers.wind.cold: The cold stiffens the wind: slower to gather, slower to return.
message.jaymospowers.wind.fumble: The wind tugs %s from your grip!
message.jaymospowers.wind.fumble_carried: The wind tears %s from your arms!
power.jaymospowers.wind.key.ability_2.co: Hold up to 5s: Tailwind / on ground: gust blast; lightning strikes where it lands
power.jaymospowers.wind.key.ability_3.co: Hold: Gale Barrier (shield); a bolt strikes the nearest foe
power.jaymospowers.wind.key.mode.ascende: Tempest mode on/off: wind turns arrows aside, abilities 1.25x stronger (costs hunger)
power.jaymospowers.wind.key.mode.corrupt: Stormbound mode on/off: your hits stun and build static (costs hunger)
power.jaymospowers.wind.key.mode.ascende: Thunderhead mode on/off: Tempest and Stormbound at once (costs hunger)

message.jaymospowers.aether.arrived: The Aether. Fall off its edge to go home.
message.jaymospowers.aether.lore: This is the Aether, the sky the world once had. It scattered remnants of itself across the Overworld: the monoliths, and the four Giants below. Highfields, magnetic woods, frozen lakes and irradiated wastes float here, on great islands of holystone with broken islets drifting above them, under a day and a night of their own.
message.jaymospowers.aether.home: You fall out of the Aether and the wind catches you, high above the world.
